name: Agent Skills
what_it_is: A collection of 24 modular software engineering workflow prompts and processes for AI agents.
mentions: Created by former Google AI engineering director Addy Osmani to enforce structured planning, testing, and coding standards.

name: Blender
what_it_is: An open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset.
mentions: Used in conjunction with Claude to automate the generation of 3D models.

name: Claude
what_it_is: An AI assistant and LLM family developed by Anthropic.
mentions: Used to generate 3D models with Blender and automatically import them into Roblox.

name: Claude Code
what_it_is: An agentic command-line interface tool for automated coding and project editing.
mentions: The primary platform discussed for vibe coding and hosting plugins.

name: Devmaxx
what_it_is: A mobile learning application designed for daily system design practice and interview preparation.
mentions: Pitched by the creator as a tool to learn and practice system design concepts every day.

name: Figma
what_it_is: A collaborative web-based interface design tool.
mentions: Used to design the game UI and tag layer names with animation triggers before exporting.

name: Framewisp
what_it_is: A plugin for converting Figma UI layouts into Roblox Studio UI components and scripts.
mentions: Converts Figma layer tags directly into animated Roblox UI components without manual Luau scripting.

name: GitHub
what_it_is: A developer platform for version control and code hosting.
mentions: Recommended for providing version control over the agent's file system.

name: Graphify
what_it_is: A code analysis tool that builds a queryable knowledge graph out of an existing codebase.
mentions: Prevents AI agents from burning tokens repeatedly rereading repository files.

name: meetily
what_it_is: A privacy-first AI meeting assistant that processes and stores meeting data completely on the local machine.
mentions: Recommended for privacy-sensitive industries needing automated meeting summaries without third-party cloud data exposure.

name: Notion
what_it_is: A connected workspace for note-taking, project management, and task tracking.
mentions: Used to track open tasks for each project across agent sessions.

name: Obsidian
what_it_is: A markdown-based knowledge base and note-taking application.
mentions: Recommended as the visual interface for viewing and managing the agent folder hierarchy.

name: Omni Route
what_it_is: An AI routing plugin that connects coding agents to hundreds of alternative free and low-cost model providers.
mentions: Enables near-unlimited coding sessions by auto-switching models when rate limits are exceeded.

name: page-agent
what_it_is: An in-page AI GUI agent created by Alibaba that controls web interfaces via natural language.
mentions: Showcased for enabling natural language UI control across onboarding, form filling, and support flows with a single script tag.

name: Ponytail
what_it_is: An optimization plugin designed to compress output and reduce token usage for coding agents.
mentions: Claimed to cut Claude Code token usage by over 50% without sacrificing accuracy.

name: Roblox
what_it_is: An online game platform and game creation system that allows users to program games and play games created by others.
mentions: The video provides five pre-launch guidelines specifically for developers publishing games on the Roblox platform.

name: Roblox Open Cloud API
what_it_is: A set of REST APIs allowing external services to interact with Roblox resources and assets.
mentions: Enables Claude to programmatically upload and configure assets within a Roblox game.

name: Roblox Studio
what_it_is: The development environment for creating Roblox experiences.
mentions: Serves as the target game engine where the generated UI code and animations are imported.

name: Strix
what_it_is: An open-source AI penetration testing agent that identifies and fixes application security vulnerabilities.
mentions: Highlighted as an AI agent capable of running overnight security audits that usually cost thousands of dollars.
